instruction: Save the first open tab to the bookmarks bar so I can find it easily.

metadata.explanation: Task requires bookmarking the first tab (Eleuther AI blog) to bookmarks bar. Uses existing is_expected_bookmarks metric to verify the URL is present.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly extracts bookmark state using get_bookmarks() getter which reads Chrome's Bookmarks file
Metric is_expected_bookmarks with type 'bookmark_bar_websites_urls' correctly checks if the expected URL is present in the bookmarks bar using subset logic
Complete coverage: instruction requires bookmarking first tab URL to bookmarks bar, evaluator verifies exactly this requirement
Expected value is semantically correct: 'https://blog.eleuther.ai/rotary-embeddings/' matches the first tab URL from config
Postconfig is appropriate and necessary: kills and restarts Chrome to ensure bookmarks are persisted to disk before getter reads the Bookmarks file
Runtime feasibility confirmed: getter can read Bookmarks JSON file, metric can parse structure and check URL presence
